Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. About the Team

The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.

vizm-5203649007.title: Licensing Coordinator
vizm-5203649007.raw:
About Our Company

VIZ Media has been bringing the finest in manga, anime, and global entertainment to English-speaking fans across the world for nearly 40 years. From classic series like Dragon Ball, Sailor Moon, and Naruto to current hits like My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer, and Chainsaw Man, we continue to offer the best in action, romance, fantasy, and adventure stories for fans of all ages.

Our critically acclaimed manga, graphic novels, and books have won Eisner, YALSA, and Hugo awards and are available in both print and digital editions, and our premier catalog of anime titles can be seen on TV and via streaming and digital download, as well as in collectible Blu-ray and DVD sets at major retailers.

Learn more about VIZ Media, anime, and manga at www.viz.com.

Job Summary

VIZ Media, the world leader in English-language versions of manga and anime (Japanese comics and animation), is looking for a Licensing Coordinator to support our CPG Licensing & Promotions department. The Licensing Coordinator supports the Consumer Products Licensing team by coordinating day-to-day licensing operations across multiple entertainment properties and licensed categories. This role serves as a central point of coordination between internal departments, licensors, licensing agents, and licensees to ensure licensing deals, approvals, reporting, and product lifecycles progress efficiently and on schedule. The Licensing Coordinator manages deal workflow, tracks approvals, prepares presentations and business materials, and supports partner, licensor, and cross-functional communications. This position is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual looking to build a career in consumer products licensing, entertainment, or brand management.

What you’ll do:

  • Coordinate day-to-day administrative support for the Consumer Products Licensing team across multiple product categories and territories.
  • Prepare Deal Memos and supporting documentation for internal and licensor approval.
  • Track licensing opportunities from deal submission through execution using internal project management systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of licensees, agreements, product categories, approvals, reporting, and key business milestones.

VIZ Media has been bringing the finest in manga, anime, and global entertainment to English-speaking fans across the world for nearly 40 years. Job Summary

VIZ Media, the world leader in English-language versions of manga and anime (Japanese comics and animation), is looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our Original Publishing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized and detail-oriented candidate with a passion for publishing to join the Original Publishing team at VIZ Media. The team publishes a range of different formats, including manga, art books, cookbooks and novels. 

The Business Operations Associate will report to and assist the Senior Publishing Director, Original Publishing in facilitating the Original Publishing department’s publishing operations, ensuring all information is disseminated appropriately. This position is responsible for updating and maintaining internal databases and trackers, ensuring metadata and sales information is correct, and working closely with Publishing Operations, Publishing Production, Editorial and Sales. In addition, this role will ensure compliance with Licensor submission systems and will be responsible for some contracts administration and support.

What You’ll Do:

  • Gather and deliver all needed metadata and materials required for print and digital publishing distribution and coordinate with Editorial, Publishing Production, and Publishing Operations to ensure data is correct and up-to-date.
  • Navigate internal databases and trackers and communicate updates and changes as required.
  • Provide product information
